V52EvidenceRegistry.verification_note: HSK testnet does not expose a confirmed Etherscan-compatible verification API at buildathon time. Bytecode/source match can be checked manually — see README.md 'Verificación de código'.

smoke_test.description: anchorCase() called once after deploy to prove end-to-end write/read on testnet.

notes: Testnet deployment for development/demo purposes. HSK Mainnet (chain_id 177) is the buildathon objective per PROYECTO-FINAL.md; testnet is used here as the contingency environment while mainnet funding/issuer wiring is confirmed.

Deployer key is the same wallet used for the x402 Avalanche Fuji buyer test (v52-onchain/x402-test/.env, BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY). It is funded on HSK testnet independently and is NOT the Avalanche facilitator/relayer wallet.

The deployer address is also the sole allow-listed issuer at deploy time. Add the Vector52 backend's relayer wallet as an additional issuer via setIssuer() before wiring POST /v1/cases/{case_id}/anchor to this deployment.
